answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose KdConv, a Chinese multi-domain dataset towards multi-turn Knowledge-driven Conversation... We provide benchmark models ... to facilitate further research. Extensive experiments demonstrate that these models can be enhanced by introducing knowledge, whereas there is still much room in knowledge-grounded conversation modeling for future work.

answer_2.quote: We measured the performance of all the retrieval‑based models using Hits@1 and Hits@3... We also calculated Perplexity (PPL) to evaluate whether the generation result is grammatical and fluent. BLEU-1/2/3/4 is a popular metric... Distinct-1/2/3/4 is also provided to evaluate the diversity of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: Human annotators were asked to score a generated response in terms of the fluency and coherence... We randomly sampled about 500 contexts... generated responses by each model... These ... were presented to three human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each response on fluency (0‑2) and coherence (0‑2) based on whether the response is fluent, natural, relevant, and coherent to the context and knowledge information.
